mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS < 4.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL change exceeding 0.3% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%) signal stagflation risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS < 4.5 AND CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a recessionary labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE > 4.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1450 thousand units indicate weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods with HOUST < 1450 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index above 105 indicates strong economic activity, reducing risk aversion and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in periods with INDPRO > 105 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low housing starts (HOUST < 1450) and low retail sales (RSAFS < 700000) indicate weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in periods with HOUST < 1450 AND RSAFS < 700000 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% signals accommodative policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS < 4.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
